H-huh…?
It rebooted…? Really?
Ahh!
Eliza, watch out!
I dash off towards #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF.
Master!
Master!
#RUBSMaster#RUBEDear#REND―!?

Ouch………
Seems I fell over from the blast.
Mmn… ugh…
………hm? Between my arms?

Huh…… I'm…………
……why did you…………?
Umm, err… good morning…?
…half of that happened, right?

She's half-asleep.
FUUULLLYYY half-asleep.

And when she hears about this later,
I bet she'll smash her head against the wall
in embarrassment―――!

She may be our enemy,
but I can't bear to let her embarrass herself further.
She's still staring at me, deluded. I say to her,
"Snap out of it! Wake up!"
Enemies… you and I…
――――What?
Wait, uhh……………… what……?

E-everyone!
Umm, err, well… What's done is done,
so how about just a bonk on the head…?

And here it is………
So this is how everyone felt back with
my first #C000246204SG#CDEF…
I know what your secret is――!
Lovestruck!
Cinderella!

O' possessor of whipped cream filled thoughts
and a heartburn inducing mind:

…Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF, please don't smash the keyboard.
I suppose I'll have to specify the #C000246204SG#CDEF's name.
"Cinderella"! How's that!?

She's no neglected princess, she'd be the evil
step sister at best!
That's like calling #C236196003Julius#CDEF a prince!
Uck-no way, that can't……… …aaah!
I see. So that's what she desires…

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

private room.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

I'm so glad you could make it, #[piggy][squirrely]#!
Are you ready to enjoy my special concert!?

Here, in what appears to be the
furthest portion of this floor,
an eager #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF and semi-impatient #C236196003Shinji#CDEF
were waiting for us.

Between the two of them,
something is exuding a fierce presence―――

Its basic exterior looks no different than
the enemies deployed on the Hill of Hell.
But I'm getting a bad feeling about it.

Huh… the hell do you mean, "special concert"?
Don't you get it? I prepped this guy
so we can hide you.

So why did you come out anyway? Did my words go
in one ear and out the other? Is there actually
a birdbrain in that dragon head?

You're the dumb one here, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF. Letting anyone
other than me have the limelight in my Labyrinth
is disrespectful to my audience.

Victory doesn't end merely with your opponent's
defeat. A noble makes them prostrate both their
body and mind, then stomps all over them.

A rat like you probably can't understand
such etiquette… but no matter.
I'll make an exception, just this once.

This golem can shoot out of lots of flashy
laser beams and stuff, right? Then I'll do you
the favor of using it for my opening act.

My first song will be flashy, anyhow. Openings
need to hit it off with electrifying rock―――
That's the tried-and-true rule for concerts!

Ohhh, is that right?
Then I'll let you have the floor first,
but don't say I didn't warn you, after.

That's #RUBS       the favorite's#RUBEbecause your#REND chance to shine
probably won't even come!
――――get 'em, #C000246204Shinji Tank#CDEF!!!
We beat it. Beat it a little too hard.

It all ended with a blow from #C236196003#SVT#CDEF.
The #C000246204Shinji Tank#CDEF stopped moving and became silent.

I knew it… They've greatly flourished since
we last fought. …so THIS is the strength
that #[boy][girl]# had…

…this isn't―you're kidding me…!
How did #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF of all people get
THIS strong…!?

Hey, #C000246204Shinji Tank#CDEF! Move! Move, damn it!
Shit. You hunk of scrap!
You're making me look bad!!

―――At that moment, the giant that one would
expect to have ceased begins ominously vibrating.

…how do I describe #[his][her]# growth…? "Pigs rise to
the top." …that's not how it goes…
……huh? What? What's going on?

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF backs off, leaving only #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF,
who hasn't caught on to what's happening.

Meanwhile, the #C000246204Shinji Tank#CDEF's shaking
grows increasingly intense.

I don't know what's causing it.
I don't know how to stop it.
The only thing I do know is that at this rate,
it's going to explode.
The moment I sensed that, I acted immediately―――
We still need her SG!

I reach for her petite body at the same
time I sense the explosion behind her.
What the hell are you doing!?

With my entire body in pain,
I instinctively call #C236196003Sakura#CDEF.
Is #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF still in one piece?

O-okay! You only have some bruises,
scratches, and light burns―――
It doesn't look… life-threatening…

………?
She's not being completely straight with me.
Am I in bad shape somehow?

Now that I think about, I feel a little warm.
Don't tell me I'm bleedin―――

An intense flash of light disoriented me,
so I blink a few times.
The blurry world rushes back into focus.

I suddenly hear a faint moaning
coming from between my arms.

Having grasped the situation faster than me,
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's jade green eyes grew wide.

But her eyes continue to dazzle,
reflecting #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF's face as she
stares blankly.

…good morning, darling. So listen, I had
the strangest dream. If I tell you, will you
promise not to laugh?

You and I were enemies and fought. In the end,
I had you cornered, but a huge rat next to
me blew up out of nowhere.

I thought it was over for me. The blast was
going to tear us apart, but you pulled my
hand close and said:

"You don't deserve to explode. And if some
tank of oil spills on you, it would be a sin. By
the way, your horns are electrifyingly cute."

Ahh… You were so sensual and cool,
I could've just sank my teeth into your neck
right then and there…

We actually ARE enemies.
There actually WAS an explosion.
You're just confused from getting hit on the head…!
That means this is… forbidden love………?

…hm. Your lack of fidelity is quite something.
I could never hate one who understands love―
Never, but… enough! I'm starting to sulk!

Do you not have the capacity to learn?
#[You did the exact same thing][You know, this also happened]# 5 floors ago.

Why, of course we can add your reservation～!
Now get behind me, Darling.
We don't have to kill her just yet.

You fool, could it be?
Are you the pick-up artist
who only goes for the crazy women?

All hail the mighty architect of setting flags.
How about you off yourself already?

I propose developing an emotion restraint
device, a "Flag Breaker."
Here is my documentation.

My heart is being mercilessly broken by everyone's cold stares.
This isn't―isn't what it looks like.
It's all a misunderstanding, a misunderstanding…

In other news, putting my emotional scars aside,
my restless hand is indicating that a secret is manifesting.
Best if I keep this up and draw things out――

The moment I had that idea,
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's blank eyes fiercely open wide.

………HUH!?
W-what are you doing, you lowly farm animal!?
Get away from me! Get AWAY!

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF, apparently having came to her senses, flails at me.
I hurry off of her so I don't get kicked.

She stood up, face beet red, and went
straight to tidying up her hair and skirt.
…while stealing occasional glances at me.

H-how dare you save me!
I've never felt the humiliation of being saved
by a #[piggy][squirrely]# before!

Look at me! My cheeks are flushing red!
It's proof that my rage is at an all-time high!

Even my heart is beating,
"I'll never forgive you for this!"
This means my victory is assured!

Now that I'm furious, I WON'T reveal my secrets!
The only thing you'll reach is an impasse!

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF declares her victory.
However, as if refuting that claim, my hand throbs even more.

Y-y-y-you're talking out of your ass!
Maybe someone like #C236196003Rin#CDEF would fall for that,
but you won't trick me!

There's no way someone like YOU would
understand my mind!

Then this #[piggy][squirrely]# is going to show her
just how sure about it #[he][she]# is.
Extremely self-conscious!
She's forever a maiden, prone to being lovestruck.

Cursed to interpret trivial encounters#ROFS-003#RUBS the work of destiny#RUBE as romance#REND:
to see princes, white horses, and roses everywhere.

Her dreams are mellifluous.
She has "loves to fall in love" syndrome.
――――Thy name is #ROFS0002#RUBS    Sweets#RUBELovestruck#REND!

You think you can HIDE this!?!?
You're wrong, anyway!
I'm not going to forget this so easily!

I think I recall having seen a secret
like this on the first floor.
But since there's no way it can be exactly the same…

I don't think it's entirely wrong.
…still, it's #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF that we want
to know right now. Its correct name is…

You're spot on!
Not surprising, she did target YOU!
Keep going and wrap this up!
The #C000246204SG#CDEF transferred! The Shield is opening!
I hear sounds of the floor being opened up.

After revealing a secret that certainly fits how she looks,
#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's #ROFS0002#RUBS    Ego     #RUBEoffshoot#REND begins cracking and crumbling.

Huff… huff…
Looks like you really like insider stories
on idols, too, huh?

With an expression of ecstasy, she bares her fangs.
Perhaps this expression is a lingering vestige of the
secret that was drawn out of her.

But I see, this is the way I am…
These are my true feelings… I've always longed
to have love like in romance stories―――

Thank you. Now I'm aware of it.
And now say hello to the new, wonderful me!

Yes! If torture is my one and only amusement,
then to be in LOVE is my one and only dream!
When I think of love, I get more beautiful!

Being in love sustains one's beauty,
and beauty sustains being in love.
Ahh, what a sweet, infinite loop!

What was I thinking?
I can't be getting all smitten over cattle.
But―――

It's fine. I HAVE gone mad, after all.
I'm going to bestow a special honor
to little, ugly you.

―――I've reserved your soul for myself.
Laud me and my pinnacled beauty―from the
closest place next to me.
Looks like trouble is coming our way again.

Now that's a surprise.
No matter. I'll be snuffing her out, anyway.

So, there you have it. Prepare some
flowery words that degenerate dragon might
like while you have the chance.
#C236196003Rani#CDEF's voice suddenly brings me back to my senses.

The maiden disintegrated.
Only thing left to do is find the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
No point in pushing ourselves any more today.
Let's just quietly head back to the school building.
